desc: Derive the total number of monotone paths between all ordered pairs in the complete grid, or an equivalent unrestricted aggregate.
Develop a first-forbidden-contact decomposition for paths that visit the forbidden rectangle.
Derive closed forms for the aggregate number of prefixes reaching each first-contact boundary point.
Derive efficient closed forms for the suffix aggregate \(S(x,y)\) and its sum over the forbidden rectangle.
Fix the corner-entry correction by including \(x=L\) in the bottom-boundary loop.
Verify the corrected implementation against all provided samples and boundary cases.
Specify modular factorial/inverse-factorial precomputation and zero-width, zero-height, and boundary handling.
